name: Cancer Clinical Trial Access Map data API

ask.counties: ask/counties.json (compact: cols + one array per county, every county field except the by-site rates; for the question box)
ask.county_sites: ask/county_sites.json ({sites: [...], rows: {FIPS5: [[incidence rate per site], [death rate per site]]}})

fields.id: Place identifier: 5-digit county FIPS, USPS-number for a district (XX-00 is at-large), USPS code for a state, US for the nation.
fields.name: Place name. Districts: 'Texas 34th'; counties: 'Hidalgo County, Texas'.
fields.pop55: Residents aged 55 and older (ACS 5-year, summed from census tracts).
fields.pct_lt20_trials_within_60rdmi: Share (%) of residents 55+ with fewer than 20 recruiting cancer treatment trials within 60 road-miles of home. The site's headline 'short of trials' measure.
fields.people_lt20_trials_within_60rdmi: The same, as a count of people.
fields.pct_zero_trials_within_60rdmi: Share (%) with no recruiting trial within 60 road-miles.
fields.people_zero_trials_within_60rdmi: The same, as a count of people (pop55 x share, rounded; the rule used for people_lt20_trials_within_60rdmi).
fields.pct_lt100_trials_within_60rdmi: Share (%) with fewer than 100 trials within 60 road-miles.
fields.pct_gt60rdmi_broad_menu: Share (%) living more than 60 road-miles from a county with 100 or more recruiting trials (a 'broad menu').
fields.pct_gt60rdmi_nci: Share (%) living more than 60 road-miles from an NCI-designated cancer center.
fields.median_road_mi_nci: Median road miles from home to the nearest NCI-designated center (residents with a road route).
fields.median_road_mi_broad_menu: Median road miles to the nearest broad-menu county.
fields.wmean_trials_within_60rdmi: Population-weighted mean number of recruiting trials within 60 road-miles.
fields.trials_listed_here: Recruiting trials with at least one site in the place, each trial counted once. County: trials with a site in the county. District: distinct trials with a site in any county that overlaps the district (a trial in a county shared by two districts counts for both, so district figures do not add up to the state's). State: distinct trials with a site in the state. National: all recruiting trials in the pull.
fields.nearest_nci: The NCI-designated center nearest to most residents.
fields.nearest_broad_menu: The broad-menu county nearest to most residents.
fields.trials_within_60rdmi_by_cancer_type: Population-weighted mean trials within 60 road-miles, by cancer type (district and state only).
fields.context: ACS context: no_vehicle, broadband, uninsured, uninsured_55_64, poverty, all in %, population-weighted.
fields.member: Districts only: the House member, party, and cosponsorship of the Clinical Trial Modernization Act (H.R. 3521): sponsor, original, cosponsor, or none.
fields.counties: Districts only: the FIPS codes of counties that overlap the district.
fields.districts: Counties only: the ids of the congressional districts that overlap the county, in the district file's form (TX-15, XX-00 for at-large), sorted; the inverse of the districts' counties lists. A county split between districts lists each of them.
fields.links: map: the map opened on this place; brief: the printable brief for it.
fields.data_as_of: Registry data date of the ClinicalTrials.gov pull these figures come from.
fields.rucc: Counties only: USDA ERS Rural-Urban Continuum Code, 1 (metro, 1 million+) to 9 (nonmetro, urban under 5,000, not adjacent); 2023 release (2013 for Connecticut's legacy counties). null where no code is published.
fields.rucc_label: Counties only: the USDA label for the code.
fields.metro: Counties: true when the RUCC is 1-3 (metro), false for 4-9 (nonmetro), null when unknown. States and the nation: the access figures for residents of metro counties (see nonmetro).
fields.nonmetro: States and the nation: the access figures for residents of nonmetro counties (RUCC 4-9), with metro holding the same for RUCC 1-3: pop55, counties, pct_lt20 (share with fewer than 20 trials within 60 road-miles), people_lt20, pct_zero, people_zero, pct_lt100, mean_trials_60 (average trials within 60 road-miles), pct_gt60rdmi_nci, pct_gt60rdmi_broad_menu, median_road_mi_nci, median_road_mi_broad_menu. null where the state has no county of that kind (DC has no nonmetro county).
fields.road_mi_nci_from_center: Counties only: road miles from the county population center to the nearest NCI-designated cancer center (the map's 'road-miles to an NCI center' layer). null = no road route.
fields.road_mi_broad_menu_from_center: Counties only: road miles from the population center to the nearest county with 100 or more recruiting trials; 0 when the county itself hosts a broad menu. null = no road route.
fields.road_mi_limited_menu_from_center: Counties only: road miles from the population center to the nearest county with 20 or more recruiting trials; 0 when the county hosts one. null = no road route.
fields.no_road_route_reason: Counties only: null when road distances exist; 'island' when the county has no road connection to a broad menu or NCI center (island or disconnected network); 'off' when the population center is more than 30 miles from any primary or secondary road, so no road distance is reported.
fields.drive_hours_nci: Counties only: estimated driving time in hours from the population center to the nearest NCI-designated center (one decimal). null = no road route.
fields.drive_hours_broad_menu: Counties only: estimated driving time in hours to the nearest broad-menu county (one decimal). null = no road route.
fields.trials_within_60rdmi_of_center: Counties only: recruiting trials with a site within 60 road-miles of the county population center (the county-level count the map's county card shows; the pop-weighted tract figure is wmean_trials_within_60rdmi).
fields.facilities_within_60rdmi_of_center: Counties only: recruiting trial sites within 60 road-miles of the county population center.
fields.incidence: Counties only: cancer incidence from NCI State Cancer Profiles, age-adjusted per 100,000, all ages, for the period given. all = all-sites rate (null unless status is ok); cases_per_year = average annual new cases, all sites; small_numbers = true when fewer than 16 average annual cases (interpret with caution); status = ok | suppressed (fewer than 16 cases in the period) | no data; status_text = the wording the map prints; by_site = rate per site key (null where not published; site labels are in index.json thresholds.site_labels).
fields.mortality: Counties only: cancer death rates from NCI/CDC State Cancer Profiles (National Vital Statistics System), age-adjusted per 100,000, all ages, for the period given. all = all-sites death rate; deaths_per_year = average annual cancer deaths, all sites; small_numbers = fewer than 16 deaths a year on average; status, status_text and by_site as for incidence.
fields.oncologists: County: count = oncologists (CMS Care Compare primary specialty medical oncology, hematology/oncology or hematology) with a Medicare practice location in the county; radiation, gynecologic, surgical = the same for those specialties; within_60rdmi = oncologists within 60 road-miles of the population center; class 1-4 and class_label = the map's 'oncologists vs trials' category (1 Oncologists and trials, 2 Oncologists, no trials, 3 Trials, no oncologist listed, 4 Neither); all_also_elsewhere = true when every oncologist counted also lists a location in another county (likely a part-time or outreach clinic). District, state, national: count = oncologists practising in the place (district: in counties touching it); oncologists_per_100k_pop55 (state, national); pct_pop55_in_counties_with_oncologists_no_trials, pct_pop55_in_counties_with_both, pct_pop55_in_counties_with_neither = shares of residents 55+ by county category; counties_with_oncologists_no_trials = how many such counties (district: their FIPS codes).
fields.incidence_above_county_median: Counties only: true when the all-sites incidence rate is above the median of US counties with a published rate (the 'high incidence' half of the map's incidence-vs-access layer; the median is in index.json thresholds). null when the rate is not published.
fields.mortality_top_third: Counties only: true when the all-sites cancer death rate is in the top third of US counties with a published rate (the 'high mortality' part of the deaths-vs-access layer; the cut is in index.json thresholds). null when the rate is not published.
fields.nonmetro_pct: Districts and states: share (%) of residents 55+ living in nonmetro counties (RUCC 4-9).
fields.incidence_all_sites: Districts, states and the nation: all-sites age-adjusted incidence per 100,000, as the map's incidence layer paints it: the residents-55+-weighted mean of county rates (incidence_all_sites_cases_per_year = the matching annual cases, county counts shared out by residents 55+).
fields.incidence_all_sites_cases_per_year: Districts, states and the nation: average annual new cases, all sites, behind incidence_all_sites (county counts shared out by residents 55+, so 'about').
fields.incidence_published: States and the nation: the published state/national rates from State Cancer Profiles, all = all-sites rate, cases_per_year, by_site = rate per site key (the figure the state card leads with; districts have only the county-weighted mean).
fields.senators: States only: the two senators (name, party) and, as s4440, each one's position on the Senate Clinical Trial Modernization Act (S. 4440): sponsor, original (original cosponsor), cosponsor, or none; bill and bill_url name the bill. Empty for DC.

rucc_labels.4: Nonmetro, urban population 20,000+, adjacent to a metro area
rucc_labels.6: Nonmetro, urban population 5,000–20,000, adjacent to a metro area
rucc_labels.8: Nonmetro, urban population under 5,000, adjacent to a metro area
rucc_labels.9: Nonmetro, urban population under 5,000, not adjacent
